paragraphs.text: Active React/Vite routes, Supabase queries/RPCs, and PostgreSQL schema in the batuan-voting workspace.
CargoExpressFlowchart.docx and the CargoExpressPH source tree; Figure 2–8 decomposition retained as the organizing pattern.
All flowchart nodes are Word table cells with editable text and formatting. No diagram screenshot is embedded.
Public visitor, student voter, and administrator / election manager.
The diagram pages use a dark canvas with light, editable node cells to echo the supplied reference while keeping content customizable in Word.

To customize: click inside any node cell, replace the text, then adjust the cell fill/border if needed. Use the Y/N columns as branch labels; duplicate a row when adding a new decision. The structure is intentionally table-based so it remains editable in Word, LibreOffice, and Google Docs import.

The active client routes data through src/api/client.js to Supabase public reads and app_* PostgreSQL RPCs. The legacy README wording about Express/MySQL is not used as the source of truth for these flowcharts.

All voter mutations call require_admin through app_* RPCs. The UI previews bulk uploads and reports inserted, skipped duplicate, and error counts.

The active API client uses app_add_candidate/app_update_candidate RPCs and Supabase Storage for candidate photos. Candidate rows are filtered by archived = false for public and ballot views.
Connector 4 — soft-delete safety flow for voters and candidates
Display archived voters table; search by LRN, name, section
Set archived = false; return to active voter list
Confirm then hard delete user and cascaded records
Display archived candidates table; search by name, position, party
Set archived = false; return to active candidate list
Toast success; invalidate archive and active-list queries
Archive is reversible soft delete. Permanent delete is destructive and confirmation-gated; database foreign keys cascade related records where defined.

src/pages/Results.jsx owns live/history tabs, Supabase Realtime, filters, winners summary, archived results, and admin-only print. Public users can view results; only admins see the print action and edit election name.
Use this page as a human-editable index when revising the flowchart for a new election year or school workflow.

1) Update election names, dates, and role labels. 2) Keep Y/N branches aligned with the condition. 3) If a route or RPC changes, update the corresponding source-map row and implementation anchor. 4) Re-open the document in Word and inspect each landscape page after edits.

The supplied CargoExpress flowchart used dark backgrounds and light nodes with Figure 2–8 decomposition. This document keeps that visual cue but replaces screenshot-based figures with editable tables so a human can change labels, branches, and implementation notes directly.
